title: std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::~multimap
summary: A destructor. Destructs the multimap. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.
html:
~multimap();

A destructor. Destructs the multimap. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the multimap.
